verification.results: All configure/build/native invocations exit 0. Accumulated run includes M1 once and initial 34 host cases. Directly related test/header/caller changes pass the two affected entries with 37 host cases and 6 caller scenarios. A final test-only actual actor-insertion-order witness change passes the host entry alone (37 cases); production host/caller remain unchanged. No sanitizer findings.

implemented_contracts: Private finite deterministic spoken reference host consumes actual owned immutable M1 plans, with no provider/network/callback/physics/Engine or sibling dependency
Real S1-S4 and novel mixed-school healing-plus-slow execution, independent full literal before/release/onset/expiry states, headless caller with actual moved actors and observed results

Host-local actor slot/generation identities and live permission/contact/resources; opaque host-incarnation single-use prepare/release tickets reject default, foreign, superseded, stale and repeated inputs; preview is pure
Current exact symbolic key AND primitive, quantity/duration schema and capability validation before release and delayed activation; enum-only dispatch cannot authorize a foreign/changed key
Caster pays10 mana/effect exactly once at accepted release; delayed casts reserve a bounded slot and freeze accepted G0 world aim; no automatic retry or refund after accepted release/cancellation
Current eligible living actor centres queried at activation with inclusive checked distance; onset100 and duration200 ticks, status expiry before same-tick action-ID-ordered activation
All bindings resolve before writes; cross-binding actor/health or actor/speed conflicts refuse, active slow replacement/stacking refuses, health clamps and pre-activation eligibility is explicit

Whole finite state/resource/queue/action/observation staging before nonthrowing adoption; failed advances preserve clock, prior statuses, actors, resources and entire queue including earlier scratch actions
Immutable owned old observations outlive host and plan; pending slots retain real M1 handles without deep text/program copies; explicit cancellation frees slot and retained handle

Bounds for actors/statuses/queue, selector and selected-target complete-step work, charged total work, retained per-plan logical bytes, positions/scalars and checked time/action/ticket/revision/generation horizons
M1 regression suite retained and run once; complete command/stdout/stderr/immediate exit status logs saved; only two affected entries rechecked after directly related changes
limitations: Finite private reference owner, not public Engine combat/runtime integration or a security sandbox against arbitrary native callers; owner edits and host-local logical IDs are trusted
Runtime supports spoken release contact and immediate/delayed inclusive G0 disks only; ray, engraved/item-event S5 and non-G0 bindings explicitly refuse without retargeting
No item charges, authenticated event dispatch, replay/deduplication, checkpoints/restoration, durable saves or external exactly-once delivery
Failed due action can block whole advancement until explicit owner correction/cancellation; accepted-release mana is never refunded and future targets/status capacity are not reserved
One slow per actor with no stacking/replacement/refresh; same-actor field conflicts inside an activation refuse; separate accepted actions follow chronological due tick then action ID

Coarse reference eligibility/can_cast/willingness, fixed fixture price and health rules; no line-of-sight, contact physics, faction/resistance, production balance, learner progression, graphics or fun/playtest acceptance

Resource meters are deterministic operation/logical payload models, not CPU-cycle or exact heap/RSS guarantees; allocator/control-block overhead and caller-retained output history are outside host quotas
Allocation exceptions propagate before adoption; fault injection/OOM experiments are unexecuted
GNU/Linux Debug GNU16 ASan/UBSan only; LSan tracing restriction preserves unverified leak checking, other platforms/toolchains/ABIs and installed Engine SDK remain unverified
